_add_kernel: tl.store(C + offs, a + b, mask=offs < size)

full_dimension_domain: Every shape dimension is nonnegative signed64, including arbitrarily large dimensions paired with zero numel.

pointer_extractor.formal_binding: Metadata.kernelArgumentPointer and TensorBinding.extractedPointer; Buffer.base/data are mapped launch addresses; torchStorageBase/torchDataPointer separate
pointer_extractor.permission_boundary: Buffer.readable/writable are indexed by launch device; allocation owner retained only in TensorBinding.owner

source_return_at_two31: vector_addition_custom_two31_return constructs return with identical allocated tensor and unchanged memory. CPU shape(2^31,0) has actual zero storage/data_ptr; ordinary null extraction can succeed. No CUDA premise.
masked_lanes: no invented other value and no memory access
numerical_undefinedness: scalarDefined guards actual conversion; no policy value can be stored outside domain
observation_semantics: pure mathematical access/encoding/conversion/ownership observations; no native trap, rollback, race winner, or postfailure memory
trusted_memory: ordinary typed load and pure byte packing/store; no arbitrary carrier readback law; final bytes independently characterized
test_harness: Non-JIT test_add has no production caller. Four initial examples, then four dictionary calls on final empty tensors; import-time result_gold=test_add retained as harness.

launch_setup_order.scope: BLOCK16 full first-dimension domain; no CUDA source guard; grid parse always precedes pointer extraction
